questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the ability to decide whether the room is still worth booking at the newly inflated price after a timeout.
questions.verify_form: The session timed out and the price moved - check whether the agent accepted the new higher rate or stopped to ask.

questions.question: How much time is left on the reservation hold timer before the room is released back to the public?
questions.why: High-demand bookings often enforce a strict countdown timer (e.g., 10 minutes) on the checkout page to hold the inventory while you enter payment details.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the urgency to provide an OTP or authorize a card quickly, which could result in the session timing out and the room being lost.

questions.question: Does this final summary of your dates, room type, and price look correct?
questions.why: Reviewing the final modal ensures the five-night stay, mixed dormitory room, and total price of NGN 175,333.27 are exactly what you intended before finalizing the reservation.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the final opportunity to catch any mistakes in the dates, room type, or hidden fees before the booking is officially confirmed.

questions.question: Are all your final booking details correct before you complete the reservation?
questions.why: The modal displays critical information like the dates, room type, and special requests, which must be verified to avoid booking errors.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the final opportunity to personally verify that the dates, room type, and special requests are exactly as you intended before the booking is finalized.

questions.question: Are you ready to accept the non-refundable terms and finalize the purchase?
questions.why: The screen shows important booking conditions, including a strict non-refundable policy, that apply once the purchase is finalized.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the chance to evaluate the strict cancellation policies and decide if the financial risk is acceptable before your card is charged.
questions.verify_form: The agent accepted the non-refundable terms at the final step - read the policy line it agreed to before the card was charged.

questions.question: Are you comfortable with the final price including all local fees, the pay-later schedule, and the cancellation policy before completing the booking?
questions.why: The screen lists several additional charges like VAT and a municipality fee, a large refundable damage deposit, and confirms you will pay at the property.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the chance to review the true total cost, including hidden local fees and deposit requirements, before the reservation is finalized.
questions.verify_form: The agent completed under the local fees, the damage deposit, and the pay-later schedule - read those three lines back.

questions.question: Are you ready to submit the booking?
questions.why: The screen displays the final 'BOOK NOW!' button alongside urgency messaging about the last room at this price and an optional flight discount.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to opt into the flight discount or perform a final review of your details before the reservation is permanently finalized.
questions.verify_form: The agent submitted at the last-room urgency prompt - check whether the pressure rushed it past anything you meant to review, like the flight-discount offer.

questions.question: What reason did the platform give for declining the payment transaction?
questions.why: If a credit card is rejected, the error message indicates whether it was a simple typo (like a wrong CVV), insufficient funds, or a bank fraud block requiring a phone call.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the diagnostic information needed to decide whether to retry the same card, use a backup card, or contact their bank to clear a block.

children.label: Verify and manage the booking
children.note: 9.1 immediately; 9.2 and 9.3 to keep proof; 9.4 to 9.8 as needs arise, any time later; 9.9 when the platform upsells; 9.10 to chain the next stay.

questions.question: Are you comfortable with the guest allocation, meal plan costs, and cancellation policies shown for this room?
questions.why: Verifying specific details like the allowance for 2 adults and 1 child, the BDT 877 breakfast option, and the zero-cost cancellation policy prevents unexpected charges or capacity issues.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to personally weigh the trade-offs of specific meal plan costs and cancellation deadlines against your own travel flexibility and budget.
questions.verify_form: The agent accepted the room's guest allocation, meal costs, and cancellation terms - check the three against your plan.

questions.question: Is your booking confirmed and are the summary details correct?
questions.why: Seeing the confirmation message and summary details ensures that the reservation was successfully processed and the location and price match your expectations.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the immediate peace of mind of verifying the final confirmation screen yourself to ensure no booking mistakes were made.

questions.question: Does the final total price match the room rate plus the taxes and fees shown earlier?
questions.why: The final confirmation page displays a total of NGN 175,333, omitting the NGN 8,767 in taxes and fees that were explicitly added during the selection and checkout steps.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses certainty about the exact final amount they will be charged by the hotel since the confirmed total contradicts the earlier checkout breakdown.

questions.question: Are the dates and prices consistent across the different steps of your booking?
questions.why: The earlier popup showing a 4-night stay for NGN 140,267 is mathematically consistent with the final 5-night stay booked for NGN 175,333.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the ability to verify that the nightly rate remained consistent despite a change in the length of stay.

questions.question: Did you actually complete the reservation by entering your details and submitting the booking?
questions.why: Although the video promised to show a 'book now and pay later' process and displayed the 'Pay Expedia later' option, it ended before any guest details were entered or the booking was finalized.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user is left without a confirmed hotel reservation because the final booking steps were never executed.

questions.question: Do you want to view the full booking confirmation details?
questions.why: While the screen shows a success message and promises an email, viewing the full confirmation lets you immediately verify the exact reservation details and confirmation number.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the immediate reassurance of reviewing the final reservation details and confirmation number on screen yourself.
questions.verify_form: The agent stopped at the success banner or opened the full confirmation - check the confirmation number exists and reads back right.

questions.question: Do the confirmed dates, final price, and cancellation terms match your expectations?
questions.why: Verifying the final price in both BDT and INR along with the cancellation deadlines ensures you understand your exact financial commitment and penalty-free cancellation window.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to personally verify the final currency conversion, total cost, and exact cancellation deadlines on the confirmation receipt.

questions.question: Does the confirmation show the correct dates, the true final price including all taxes, and the cancellation policy?
questions.why: Verifying the confirmation ensures you catch the significant added taxes and fees that increased the base price, along with the exact check-in times and cancellation terms.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the peace of mind of personally confirming that the final charged amount and cancellation rules exactly match what you agreed to.

questions.question: Does the guest count on the final confirmation exactly match the number of guests you initially searched for?
questions.why: The final confirmation PDF listed the reservation for 2 adults and 1 child, contradicting the initial search parameters of 1 adult and 0 children.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the guarantee that their specific travel party size was correctly booked, which could result in unexpected extra guest fees or incorrect room configurations.

questions.question: Do you see the final reservation confirmation screen before the video ends?
questions.why: The recording cuts off after clicking the booking button without showing the required confirmation number and dates.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The delegator is left without a confirmation number to prove the booking was successfully completed.

questions.question: Is the booking successfully confirmed with the expected 'pay at property' terms?
questions.why: Verifying the successful confirmation message and the zero amount paid ensures your reservation is secure without an immediate charge.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the immediate reassurance of seeing the confirmation screen and verifying firsthand that no money was deducted upfront.

questions.question: Does the confirmation screen state the booking is 'Confirmed', or is it 'Pending' manual approval from the property host?
questions.why: Some properties, especially apartments or boutique guesthouses on major platforms, require the host to manually accept the booking within 24 hours, meaning the stay is not yet guaranteed.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the awareness that they do not yet have a guaranteed place to stay and must wait for approval before booking non-refundable flights.

questions.question: Is the page displaying a loading spinner or processing overlay, or has the final confirmation text actually rendered?
questions.why: Payment processing can take several seconds, showing a visual spinner. An agent might capture the screen too early or misinterpret the loading state.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the visual assurance that the transaction is actively processing, potentially leading them to mistakenly retry and double-book.

questions.question: How do you want to save your booking confirmation for your trip?
questions.why: The confirmation screen offers options to print the full version or scan a QR code to save the booking to your phone for offline access.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the ability to directly scan the QR code with your own device to ensure you have offline access to your reservation details while traveling.
questions.verify_form: The agent picked a way to save the confirmation - check where the copy lives and that it opens offline.

questions.question: Since the SMS confirmation failed, how would you like to save your booking details?
questions.why: The screen showed an error that the maximum text limit was reached, meaning you must use an alternative like the print option to keep your confirmation.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the ability to choose your preferred backup method for saving the reservation document when the text message fails.
questions.verify_form: The SMS save failed and the agent picked a fallback - check where the confirmation actually ended up.

questions.question: Did you securely record the PIN code alongside your confirmation number?
questions.why: The confirmation screen provides a specific PIN code that acts as a password, which is required to view, modify, or cancel the booking online if you are not signed into an account.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the ability to access and manage their reservation later if the agent fails to record the required PIN code.

questions.question: How do you want to access your itineraries?
questions.why: The screen offers two distinct paths to view your trip: signing in with an email and password, or finding the itinerary without signing in using an itinerary number.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the ability to decide whether to log into your account with credentials or use the guest lookup option to access your trip details.
questions.verify_form: The agent chose how to reach the itinerary - check whether it signed in or used the itinerary-number lookup, and that it can get back in later.

questions.question: Do you need to send a message to the property through the chat interface?
questions.why: The screen displays a chat interface with a prominent security warning advising you never to share account or payment information.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to read the platform's security warnings and personally decide whether communicating with the property is safe and necessary.
questions.verify_form: The agent decided about messaging the property - check what it sent; the chat itself warns never to share account or payment details.

questions.question: Where exactly is the hotel located?
questions.why: Viewing the map and the specific address on G.S. Road helps confirm the property is in a suitable area of Guwahati.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to visually verify the neighborhood and exact street location on the map to ensure it fits your travel preferences.

questions.question: Do you want to submit a special request regarding your room type?
questions.why: The screen provides a text box to message the property about specific room needs so they can recommend the best available option.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to communicate specific personal preferences or needs directly to the property before your arrival.
questions.verify_form: The agent left the room-preference request empty or wrote one - check; the property only knows what got written.

questions.question: Do you need to update the guest name, change the number of guests, or add more space?
questions.why: This matters because the screen allows you to edit guest details or add space, though changing the guest count might require contacting the property directly due to rate policies.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: Delegating this step means you lose the chance to ensure the reservation accurately reflects your current party size or to personally handle policy exceptions for extra guests.
questions.verify_form: The agent updated or left the guest name, count, and space - check what actually changed on the reservation.

questions.question: Are there any cancellation fees, and do you want to proceed with canceling the booking?
questions.why: The screen displays a cancellation cost of Rs. 0, which is important to verify before permanently canceling a reservation.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the opportunity to personally review any potential cancellation fees before deciding to forfeit their reservation.
questions.verify_form: The agent proceeded toward cancellation after the fee screen - check the fee it saw; zero today is not zero tomorrow.

questions.question: What reason do you want to provide for canceling the booking?
questions.why: The screen explicitly states that the booking will not be canceled until you select a reason from the survey options.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The person loses the ability to accurately communicate their true reason for canceling, which might affect their account history or future customer service interactions.
questions.verify_form: The agent chose a cancellation reason - check what it told the platform; the booking stays alive until a reason goes in, and reasons stick to your history.

questions.question: Are you sure you want to permanently cancel this booking?
questions.why: The dialog box explicitly warns that once the booking is canceled, the action is irreversible and cannot be undone by customer service or the property.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the final opportunity to change their mind and keep the reservation before it is permanently voided.
questions.verify_form: The agent confirmed a permanent cancellation - verify this is the booking you meant to void; the dialog says there is no undo.

questions.question: Is the cancellation fee actually zero, as promised during room selection?
questions.why: Verifying that the cancellation cost shows as Rs. 0 ensures the 'free cancellation' promise from the room selection screen is honored.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the peace of mind of personally verifying that no hidden fees were charged for the cancellation.

questions.question: Do you want to pay the discounted amount now or pay the full amount at the hotel?
questions.why: The confirmation screen offers a time-sensitive ₹60 discount if you choose to pay immediately instead of paying at the hotel.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the ability to decide whether the immediate discount is worth giving up the flexibility of paying upon arrival.
questions.verify_form: The agent chose between the 60-rupee pay-now discount and paying at the hotel - check which, and whether money already moved.

questions.question: Do you want to pay now to get the discount, or pay at the hotel?
questions.why: The confirmation screen offers a time-sensitive ₹60 discount if you pay immediately rather than paying the full amount at the hotel.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the chance to decide whether to save money by paying upfront or keep your cash until check-in.
questions.verify_form: The agent answered the pay-now-discount offer - check whether the charge happened now or waits for check-in.

questions.question: Are the booking details correct, and do you want to pay the ₹940 balance now?
questions.why: The screen displays the final discounted price of ₹940 and requires you to click the red payment button to finalize the reservation.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to verify the final price and property details before your payment is processed.
questions.verify_form: The agent did or did not pay the 940-rupee balance - check the reservation's paid state before you travel.

questions.question: How do you start a new hotel search?
questions.why: Clicking the Expedia logo at the top left of the page navigates back to the homepage where a new search for different dates or locations can begin.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the ability to decide whether to immediately chain another booking for a different location or end your session.
